name: Bulb
author: fluffy
description: An ever-evolving raymarched 3D fractal. Hybrid Mandelbulb / Mandelbox / kaleidoscopic genomes breed Electric-Sheep style and morph into each other forever; the music restructures the geometry; the camera flies along the surface so detail never stops growing.

actions.label: ♥ Keep this look
actions.hint: Saves the current genome into the breeding pool with a like. Liked genomes get picked as parents more often, so over time the fractal evolves toward what you keep. (Keyboard: L while the wallpaper window has focus.)

actions.label: ⏭ Next sheep
actions.hint: Morphs quickly into the next bred genome instead of waiting out the current one.

actions.label: ✨ Fresh genome
actions.hint: Breeds from scratch instead of from the pool — a completely new species.

intensity.label: Music intensity
intensity.hint: How much the music restructures the fractal: bass raises the Mandelbulb power and fold scale, beats snap the rotations, strong hits dive the camera and mutate the next genome. 0 = evolve on its own.

evolveSpeed.label: Evolution speed
evolveSpeed.hint: How fast one genome ('sheep') morphs into the next. 1 = a new one every 25-50 s, faster when the music is loud.

cameraSpeed.label: Flight speed
cameraSpeed.hint: Speed of the camera as it flies along the fractal surface. It always slows down near detail; 0 hovers in place.

detail.label: Detail (iterations)
detail.hint: Adds or removes fractal iterations. More = finer, more intricate structure but heavier on the GPU. Detail also grows on its own over each genome's life and with loud music.

rayScale.label: Fractal render resolution
rayScale.hint: Fraction of screen resolution the raymarcher renders at (it is upscaled and temporally smoothed). auto follows the quality tier (0.5 at high). 1.0 is very heavy even on an RTX 3070.

glow.label: Glow
glow.hint: Volumetric glow that gathers around fine structure, plus bloom. Treble brightens it.

fog.label: Fog / depth
fog.hint: Distance fog: higher values fade far structure into darkness for more depth; 0 shows everything crisp to the horizon.

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.hint: Overall exposure of the fractal. Lower it for a darker, moodier look.

sporeAmount.label: Spore network
sporeAmount.hint: Faint slime-mold network crawling over the bright parts of the fractal. 0 turns the simulation off (saves a little GPU).

clockScale.label: Clock size
clockScale.hint: Size of the spore-crowd clock on each monitor.

clockX.label: Clock horizontal position
clockX.hint: Where the clock sits across each monitor: 0.05 at the left edge, 0.5 centred, 0.95 at the right edge. It never leaves the screen.

clockY.label: Clock vertical position
clockY.hint: 0.1 near the top, 0.5 centred, 0.9 near the bottom.

clockContrast.label: Clock shadow / solidity
clockContrast.hint: Darkens the fractal around the digits and lays a solid tint under the spore crowd so the time always reads. 0 = spores only.

showSeconds.label: Show seconds
showSeconds.hint: Small seconds next to the time; the crowd re-forms every second.

showDate.label: Show day and date
showDate.hint: Second line under the time, e.g. TUE · SEP 15.
